paragraphs.text: 1. FROM out the earth I dig this plant, a herb of most effectual power,
Wherewith one quells the rival wife and gains the husband for oneself.
paragraphs.original: यया सपत्नीं बाधते यया संविन्दते पतिम्
paragraphs.translit: yayā sapatnīṃ bādhate yayā saṃvindate patim

paragraphs.text: 2. Auspicious, with expanded leaves, sent by the Gods, victorious plant,
Blow thou the rival wife away, and make my husband only mine.
paragraphs.original: सपत्नीं मे परा धम पतिं मे केवलं कुरु
paragraphs.translit: sapatnīṃ me parā dhama patiṃ me kevalaṃ kuru

paragraphs.text: 3. Stronger am 1, O Stronger One, yea, mightier than the mightier;
And she who is my rival wife is lower than the lowest dames.
4. Her very name I utter not: she takes no pleasure in this man.
paragraphs.original: नह्यस्या नाम गृभ्णामि नो अस्मिन्रमते जने ।
paragraphs.translit: nahyasyā nāma gṛbhṇāmi no asminramate jane |

paragraphs.text: Far into distance most remote drive we the rival wife away.
5. I am the conqueror, and thou, thou also act victorious:
As victory attends us both we will subdue my fellow-wife.
paragraphs.original: उभे सहस्वती भूत्वी सपत्नीं मे सहावहै
paragraphs.translit: ubhe sahasvatī bhūtvī sapatnīṃ me sahāvahai

paragraphs.text: 6. I have gained thee for vanquisher, have grasped thee with a stronger spell.
As a cow hastens to her calf, so let thy spirit speed to me, hasten like water on its way.
paragraphs.original: मामनु प्र ते मनो वत्सं गौरिव धावतु पथा वारिव धावतु
paragraphs.translit: māmanu pra te mano vatsaṃ gauriva dhāvatu pathā vāriva dhāvatu
